title: Half-sandwich ruthenium(II), rhodium(III) and iridium(III) fluorescent metal complexes containing pyrazoline based ligands: DNA binding, cytotoxicity and antibacterial activities.
authors: Nongpiur, Carley Giffert L; Verma, Akalesh Kumar; Singh, Rohit Kumar; Ghate, Mayur Mohan; Poluri, Krishna Mohan; Kaminsky, Werner; Kollipara, Mohan Rao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究含吡唑啉配体的半夹心金属配合物的DNA结合、细胞毒性与抗菌活性，虽涉及DNA结合但为小分子配体结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主，仅含分子对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of nine new complexes of ruthenium(II), rhodium(III), and iridium(III) incorporated with pyrazoline-based ligands were synthesized and characterized by various spectroscopic techniques such as FTIR, (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, UV-Vis spectroscopy, ESI-MS spectrometry and X-ray crystallographic studies. All the synthesized compounds were assessed for their antibacterial abilities against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacterial strains. The compounds showed better antibacterial activity against two Gram-positive bacteria (Staphylococcus aureus and Bacillus Thuringiensis), with activities superior to standard kanamycin. Antioxidant studies revealed the mild radical scavenging proficiency of the compounds. DNA binding studies using fluorescence spectroscopy showed that the compounds could bind to Salmon Milt DNA electrostatically via external contact and groove surface binding with moderate affinity. The synthesized complexes were tested for anticancer activity using cell cytotoxicity and apoptosis assays in Dalton's lymphoma (DL) cell lines. The findings were compared to cisplatin (the standard drug) under identical experimental conditions. The cell viability results showed that complex 7 induced higher cytotoxicity in the DL cell line than the other tested compounds. The results of the molecular docking analysis further suggest that selective complexes have complete contact with the active amino acids sites of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein.
abstract_zh: 合成并表征了一系列九个含吡唑啉配体的钌(II)、铑(III)和铱(III)新配合物，并通过多种光谱技术如FTIR、1H NMR、13C NMR、UV-Vis光谱、ESI-MS质谱及X射线晶体学研究进行了表征。所有合成化合物均评估了其对革兰氏阳性菌和革兰氏阴性菌株的抗菌能力。这些化合物对两种革兰氏阳性菌（金黄色葡萄球菌和苏云金芽孢杆菌）表现出更好的抗菌活性，其活性优于标准卡那霉素。抗氧化研究表明，这些化合物具有温和的自由基清除能力。使用荧光光谱法进行的DNA结合研究表明，这些化合物可通过外部接触和沟槽表面结合以中等亲和力静电结合鲑鱼精子DNA。合成的配合物在道尔顿淋巴瘤（DL）细胞系中通过细胞毒性和凋亡试验测试了抗癌活性。结果与顺铂（标准药物）在相同实验条件下进行了比较。细胞活力结果表明，与其他测试化合物相比，配合物7在DL细胞系中诱导了更高的细胞毒性。分子对接分析结果进一步表明，选择性配合物与抗凋亡Bcl-2家族蛋白的活性氨基酸位点具有完全接触。
